onset: Same BasicOnsetDetector,full-length signal,no cropping before detection; same f64 FFmpeg stereo mean, no additional normalization, then restrict[0,330). No PLP detector input.
geometry: Exact parent cells,tie distance/earlier timestamp/ID,no borrowing or reuse; source labels separator hypotheses
matching: All full-mix native events versus each stem separately, inclusive tolerance ONE hop=512/44100 seconds (11.609977ms), sample-index arithmetic <=512. This is a resolution-based association, not calibrated physical accuracy. Bipartite connected components: mutual degree1 edges unique MATCH;degree0 unmatched;all other components AMBIGUOUS/MULTIPLE, no nearest forced resolution. No cross-cell constraint for matching. Preserve all edges and all unmatched.
matching_rationale: One analysis hop is existing detector timestamp resolution; uncertainty is not equated to this tolerance. Displacements >one hop remain unmatched, not repaired. Conditional matched statistics are tolerance-truncated and cannot alone prove timing preservation.
stem_pair: Same-cell selected Bass/Drums separate observations; abs difference>512samples distinguishes; <=512 unresolved, including equal times; no physical independence inference
Dual_classification: Per full-mix shared-Dual cell: neither E;onlyBass A;onlyDrum B;both >1 candidate in either stem F(multiple) primary,retain secondary selected-pair distinguishability;otherwise C if selected difference>512samples,D if<=512. No automatic deblending claim.
metrics: Full populations, source-state crossmatch classes, coverage, unique/ambiguous/unmatched, conditional matched FM-minus-stem displacement; selected offsets all and resolvedpair signs; section summaries; no threshold fitting
decisions: More candidates/coverage is observability gain, not true-source accuracy. COMPLEMENTARY when both unmatched fullmix-supported and stem-only activity exist; cleaner labels cannot establish STEMS_BETTER. FULL_MIX_BETTER/STEMS_BETTER require independent supporting accuracy/preservation evidence; otherwise INSUFFICIENT. Timing SUPPORTED only with complete unambiguous event preservation at native resolution; mixed missing/new/ambiguous => MIXED, physical degradation not inferred without reference. Dual USEFUL/LIMITED means diagnostic distinguishable observations, not physical split truth. Overall default FULL_MIX operational;HYBRID_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY if stems add localized diagnostic observability while ambiguity/loss remains. No adoption.
expectation: REPRODUCED if Bassnegative majority,Drumpositive majority andresolvedpairsBassfirst majority;PARTIALLY_REPRODUCED if only subset;NOT_REPRODUCED if none;INSUFFICIENT if no required observations. Also disclose fullmixmatchedpairqualification.
stop: Source/model/config mismatch, unproven temporal alignment, detector/preparation mismatch or changed parents stops dependent evaluation.
